resources.string: Equalizer, effects, resampler, Bit-Perfect and output profiles
DropSync works completely offline. There are no analytics, no ads and no network transfers. Song hashes come only from marker files you import yourself.
Choose how music behaves during workout rest periods. Off keeps your normal playback (e.g. shuffle) running.
Do not interfere. Your queue and shuffle keep playing as usual.
During a rest, play a playlist labelled \"Rest / break\"; when the rest ends, start a track from a \"Work\" playlist.
Like the rest playlist, plus timing a \"Work\" track so its drop lands exactly at the end of the rest.
Play a short 3-2-1 lead-in (haptics + tone) before a rest timer starts.
Choose which durations appear as chips in the rest dialog.
Weight shuffle by play count and favorites and avoid recently played tracks.
